head/.claude/adapters/loa_cheval/providers/agy_headless_adapter.py:125 — [high] With the opt-in off by default, every stock Google fallback_chain still ends in `google:gemini-headless`. So when the HTTP hops fail with walkable errors (rate limit, 5xx, disconnect), the walk reaches the agy terminal, and `AgyOptInRequiredError` (a non-retryable ChevalError) goes to cheval's hard-abort arm (cheval.py:2544).
